xna-type.name: GameWindow
xna-type.summary: The system window associated with a Game.

property.name: AllowUserResizing
property.summary: Specifies whether to allow the user to resize the game window.
property.syntax: [DefaultValueAttribute(false)] public virtual abstract bool AllowUserResizing { get; set; }

property.name: ClientBounds
property.summary: The screen dimensions of the game window's client rectangle.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract Rectangle ClientBounds { get; }

property.name: CurrentOrientation
property.summary: Gets the current display orientation, which reflects the physical orientation of the phone in the user's hand.
property.remarks: Windows Phone Specific Information Orientation settings apply only to Windows Phone-based games.

property.name: Handle
property.summary: Gets the handle to the system window.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract IntPtr Handle { get; }

property.name: ScreenDeviceName
property.summary: Gets the device name of the screen the window is currently in.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract string ScreenDeviceName { get; }

property.name: Title
property.summary: Gets and sets the title of the system window.

method.name: BeginScreenDeviceChange
method.summary: Starts a device transition (windowed to full screen or vice versa).

overload.summary: Starts a device transition (windowed to full screen or vice versa).

parameters.parameter: Specifies whether the device will be in full-screen mode upon completion of the change.

overload.remarks: This method must be called before any device change occurs (that is, before resetting the graphics device). EndScreenDeviceChange should be called to complete the transition.

parameters.parameter: The desktop screen to move the window to. This should be the screen device name of the graphics device that has transitioned to full screen.

overload.remarks: This method must be called after any device change (that is, after resetting the graphics device).

parameters.parameter: The desktop screen to move the window to. This should be the screen device name of the graphics device that has transitioned to full screen.
The new width of the game's client window.
The new height of the game's client window.

overload.remarks: This method must be called after any device change (that is, after resetting the graphics device).

method.name: OnActivated
method.summary: Called when the GameWindow gets focus.

overload.summary: Called when the GameWindow gets focus.

method.name: OnClientSizeChanged
method.summary: Called when the size of the client window changes. Raises the ClientSizeChanged event.

overload.summary: Called when the size of the client window changes. Raises the ClientSizeChanged event.

method.name: OnDeactivated
method.summary: Called when the GameWindow loses focus.

overload.summary: Called when the GameWindow loses focus.

method.name: OnOrientationChanged
method.summary: Called when the GameWindow display orientation changes.

overload.summary: Called when the GameWindow display orientation changes.

method.name: OnPaint
method.summary: Called when the GameWindow needs to be painted.

overload.summary: Called when the GameWindow needs to be painted.

method.name: OnScreenDeviceNameChanged
method.summary: Called when the GameWindow is moved to a different screen. Raises the ScreenDeviceNameChanged event.

overload.summary: Called when the GameWindow is moved to a different screen. Raises the ScreenDeviceNameChanged event.

parameters.parameter: Type: DisplayOrientation A set of supported display orientations.

method.name: SetTitle
method.summary: Sets the title of the GameWindow.

overload.summary: Sets the title of the GameWindow.

parameters.parameter: The new title of the GameWindow .

event.name: ClientSizeChanged
event.summary: Raised when the size of the GameWindow changes.

event.name: OrientationChanged
event.summary: Describes the event raised when the display orientation of the GameWindow changes. When this event occurs, the XNA Framework automatically adjusts the game orientation based on the value specified by the developer with SupportedOrientations.
event.remarks: Windows Phone Specific Information Orientation settings apply only to Windows Phone-based games.

event.name: ScreenDeviceNameChanged
event.summary: Raised when the GameWindow moves to a different display.
